card.name: Space before days after CABG trials
card.fires_on: The space right after "in the first" in the NSAID warning about pain treatment after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery, just before the number of days (10–14).

modes.label: CABG trial sentence
modes.description: The space after "the first" where a day count such as 10 to 14 comes next, in the COX-2 NSAID bypass surgery warning.
modes.example: raft (CABG) Surgery Two large, controlled clinical trials of a COX-2 selective NSAID for the treatment of pain in the first<< >>10–14 days following CAB

card.plain: It marks the spot in the bypass-surgery NSAID warning where the number of days after surgery is about to appear.
